list: The official 55 trophies, as listed before this guide was written (names, descriptions and grades: Exophase; PSN counts: PSNProfiles). 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
sources: Name, description and grade of every trophy: the official list on Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies). PSN progress targets where one exists: PSNProfiles (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). Every guide below is our own advice written from the official description alone; the game is a day old, so no guide step here has been checked in the game yet, and where a place or step is not pinned down the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime and money — and let this one land last. If it does not pop, one trophy in the list below is still unchecked; use the Missables page first, since those are the ones that can slip past.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn; there is no way to miss it and no choice that locks it out. If you are starting fresh, just follow the opening beats until the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes and this pops. No side content is needed for it; if a chapter mission feels stuck, it is a story beat, not a trophy condition.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Same rule as Chapter 1: main missions only, in order, until the chapter ends. The name is printed here exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. By this point the map is opening up, but the trophy only cares about the chapter's main missions, so side activities can wait until the roadmap's later stages.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops you are one mission away from the gold story trophy below.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. It unlocks after Chapter 4, and finishing it earns this gold trophy. The official description does not name the mission, so this guide does not guess at it; just keep following the main story until no main mission remains.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so it appears in the main mission flow; play the story until it shows up, then finish it. The description gives no location or step beyond the mission name, and this guide does not invent one.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story flow: it unlocks when the story reaches it, and finishing it is the whole requirement. Bring your best gear to a heist the way you would to any big story job; the trophy itself only asks that the mission ends complete.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another named story mission: play the main story until it appears, then finish it. No side requirement is attached to it in the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story mission by name, so it comes to you through the main missions. Finish it once and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at the airport (VCIA), so expect this one at or around the airport in the story flow. The official description names no step inside the mission, so plan on simply finishing it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A named story mission; it arrives through the main missions and pops on completion. Nothing in the official description suggests a side condition, so treat it as finish-the-mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist. This is the long grind behind the platinum: story, strangers, activities, collectibles and the rest all feed into it, so it usually pops near the very end. Use this tracker's progress as your map and clean up whatever category is still short; the in-game stats screen is the final word on what counts, and this guide does not guess at its exact checklist.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and the like, as the game counts them. This is a volume trophy: fold stunt attempts into normal driving instead of grinding them in one sitting, and watch the counter climb. A stunt counts when the game says it does; the official description sets no specific stunt type, so any stunt the game registers should feed the total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity in the game at least once — racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone races and whatever else the activities list holds. The official description does not list how many types there are, so do not trust a number from this guide: open the activities menu, work down it, and the trophy pops when the last untried type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PSN tracks 42 of them. This is a skill trophy, not a grind one: learn each challenge's target pattern, take the range slowly, and gold them one at a time. It is the hardest silver on the list for most players, so leave it for stage 3 when your aim and weapon handling are warmed up.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Visit every drone-race spot on the map and win once at each; the trophy tracks locations, not total wins, so a second win at the same spot adds nothing. The official description does not say how many locations there are, so use the map markers rather than a number from this guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so work through the race list and tick off new ones. Any race type should count toward the 20, and the counter is what matters — keep a mental note of which races you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival the description names; find a fishing challenge against him and out-fish him. If the challenge can be retried, treat the first attempt as practice and learn the timing before going for the win — the description does not say whether it is one-shot, so do not assume it is.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game — finish one cabinet game all the way through. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you can find and play it to its end screen. Any arcade game counts, so choose by what you are best at, not by what the guide names.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Stranger-style contacts hand out a chain of missions; keep taking Andy's jobs when they appear until the strand ends. The official description names no mission count, so follow the contact, not a number.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Same pattern as Andy's: take Kenton's jobs as they come until the chain closes. If his missions stop appearing, check the map for his marker — strands usually wait on you, not the other way round.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's chain is one of five named contacts on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), so work them in parallel and tick each final mission off as it lands.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The five named contacts above are part of the eight, so you need three more stranger chains besides them. Explore the state, answer stranger markers when they appear, and finish each chain to its end — a strand only counts when its final mission is done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Take Randy's jobs as they appear until the chain ends; like the other contacts, his strand is a sequence, not a single job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. The last of the five named contacts: once Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are all done, you are five of the eight stranger strands toward the silver above.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state; visit each one and meditate there. The official description does not give a count, so track them on the map rather than counting from this guide, and pair the trip with the exploration trophy — the same road trip covers both.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting one: take his jobs, follow the trail to the unique animal he names, and bring it down. The description names no animal or place, so this guide does not guess at either — follow Bret's missions and the hunt will point at its own target.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set only counts when every card in it is found, and you need three whole sets. Pick up cards as you travel rather than hunting them in one run, and check your collection screen to see which sets are one or two cards short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game tagging or check-in action the description names; do it at 100 different spots. The counter is per location, so repeating the same spot adds nothing — keep moving to new places, and fold it into the exploration road trip so the same miles feed two trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives — the shooting range, races, stunts and the rest all feed this counter. It pops naturally while you work the other activity trophies, so do not grind it alone; check the challenges list, pick the easiest unfinished ones, and let the total climb to 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it deliberately: pick an open stretch of road, rack up the heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Flagged missable because the description ties it to a specific setup — a partner present and a 4-star escape — that may not come up by accident, so plan the attempt rather than waiting for it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. The chain is the hard part: pick three shops close together, plan the route between them, and keep the heat on the whole way — losing the wanted level mid-chain breaks the run. Flagged missable because the description demands an unbroken sequence, so set it up on purpose with a fast car and a short route.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting in and driving a vehicle you have not found before should register it; vary what you drive instead of sticking to one favourite. The counter is per vehicle type, so a car park full of new models is worth more than one rare car driven twice.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a spot with at least five enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. If the first try falls short, the description sets no one-shot rule, so reposition, gather a bigger group, and try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Read plainly, that means leaving the airport in an aircraft without a scheduled flight: get to a plane at VCIA and take off on your own terms. Flagged missable because it sounds like a one-off stunt at a specific place, so do it as a planned attempt at the airport rather than hoping it happens during a mission.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the Rhino is the series' tank, so this trophy is about the Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino and do what a tank does until the trophy pops. This guide does not invent a step the description never states; the honest read is that it involves the Rhino, and the exact trigger is not pinned down by the official text.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: plan the entry, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. Flagged missable because being detected may fail the attempt — if detection ruins it, the description does not say the store can be robbed again, so save before you go in if the game allows it, and treat the first clean run as the one that counts.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Five vaults, five clean getaways: plan each robbery with an escape route before you go in, and do not count a vault until you are clear of the heat. Bank jobs are the biggest crime trophy on the list, so gear up and treat each vault as its own mission.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around the map; intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get clear of the wanted level. One truck and one clean escape is the whole trophy, so pick a quiet stretch of road for the hit and a fast car for the getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive, fly or sail into each corner of the state until the map is filled in. Pair it with the meditation spots, the WAiNK locations and the card hunt: one long road trip across the state feeds four trophies at once, and the map itself shows what is still unexplored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in the game. Every gang has operations to hit; the trophy needs one per gang, not one per operation. The official description does not list the gangs, so work from the map and the game's own gang markers — hit one operation for each gang name the game shows you.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or spot with a view on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail there. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a skill one: find the right seafront spot, sit down with the drink, and let it pop. The description does not name the venue, so look for the view, not a name.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Flagged missable because it reads as a single scripted-style moment at a specific place: pick a showroom, line up a fast car at its window, and go through it. If the showroom can be re-entered, a failed attempt costs nothing but the repair bill.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to its end. The venue is named in the description, so head to that alley specifically, not just any bowling lane. One full game should do it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle — 'a partnership with mass appeal' — and it names no act, place or number, so this guide will not invent one. The honest read is that it involves doing something notable together with your partner. Watch for partner activities that draw a crowd or a reaction, and check back here once players have pinned the trigger down; the guide will say so plainly when it is known.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a choice — the description says 'choices made (for better or worse)', which means a story decision that locks in one outcome. Flagged missable and spoiler-hidden because a choice trophy can be the one that never comes back: when the story offers you a real decision, make it deliberately and note which way you went. If the game lets you replay the mission, the other choice may still be open; if it does not, your first choice is the trophy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is a hint, not a task: 'second time's the charm' means succeeding at something on the second attempt after failing it once. Flagged missable because it may depend on a specific first failure followed by a second-try success — do not force-fail things at random, but when you do fail something, try it again right away instead of walking off; the retry itself may be the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Another riddle description — 'what the hell just happened?' — which points at a strange, unexpected event in the world rather than a task you can queue up. Flagged missable because a one-off world event may not repeat. Explore odd corners of Leonida, follow anything that looks out of place, and when something weird happens, stay with it until it resolves; the trophy is likely tied to seeing it through.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl pins over with a melee drive-by — hit bowling pins from a moving vehicle with a melee attack. Set it up at the bowling alley: drive past the pins slowly enough to swing and fast enough to count as a drive-by. Flagged missable because it needs a precise setup at a specific place, so plan the attempt rather than hoping it happens in traffic.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and contacts clean them for a cut; keep the loop going — rob, launder, repeat — until the laundered total hits $250,000. It is a money counter, so pair it with the bank vaults and armored trucks: the same heists feed both this and the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in the game. Buy weapons, clothes, cars, food — any shop spending counts toward the total. It pops on its own while you gear up for the other trophies, so do not force it: if it is still short late in the game, buy the big-ticket items you actually want and let the counter finish itself.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in the game. Garages are bought, not found, so this one costs money — save for it in the late game when the laundering and robbery income is flowing. The official description does not say how many garages there are, so use the property menu as the checklist and buy until no garage is left unowned.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles worth keeping, register each one through the app, and the trophy pops on the tenth. It pairs naturally with the 100-vehicle discovery trophy: register the best of what you discover as you go, and do not sell a registered vehicle until this one is done.

roadmap.title: Story first
roadmap.goal: Play the main story from Gone Fishing to the final mission.
roadmap.advice: Main missions only, in order. Chapters 1 to 4, the named missions, then the finale. Watch for the one choice trophy (Actions Speak Louder) and make story decisions deliberately.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side missions
roadmap.goal: Finish every stranger strand, starting with the five named contacts.
roadmap.advice: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone first, then Bret's hunt, then three more stranger chains to reach 8 strands for the silver. Take stranger jobs whenever their markers appear.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.goal: Clear the activity list: range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation, stunts, challenges.
roadmap.advice: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges for the silver, win 20 different races, try every activity type once, and let the 50-challenge counter fill itself along the way.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.goal: Cross Leonida once, picking up cards, vehicles and check-ins as you go.
roadmap.advice: One long road trip: explore every region, WAiNK at 100 spots, discover 100 vehicles, complete 3 card sets, register 10 vehicles. The map shows what is left.

roadmap.title: Crime and money
roadmap.goal: Rob, launder and spend: vaults, trucks, shops, gangs and garages.
roadmap.advice: Do the missables here, deliberately and in order — the shop chain, the jewelry store, the showroom, the airport departure. Then the five vaults, the gangs, and the $250,000 laundering total.

roadmap.title: Cleanup and platinum
roadmap.goal: Reach 100% completion, then take the platinum.
roadmap.advice: Check the in-game completion list against this tracker, mop up whatever category is short, and the gold for 100% lands just before the platinum.
